title: Plumeform floating nav pill
description: A rounded glass pill floating 8px from the top and sticky for the whole page: wordmark, centred links with small chevrons, a quiet sign-in link and a pill button. It turns dark glass while over dark bands and pale glass over paper; on phones it folds to wordmark, button and a menu.
notes: overlaps the next block by its own height (negative margin), so a hero runs under it
tone="auto" watches for elements with data-tone="dark" (plumeform-band sets it); pass initialTone="dark" when the page opens on a dark band
